question: In a certain code language, 'VRH' is written as 'TPJ' . How will 'LYS' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'VRH' is written as 'TPJ'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc406fef274db70fea17eb54a1ddf157e70e289665612f18086f84106eb5bdc9.png] 

Similarly,

'LYS' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/105fd6d03a200a331d4e8abe5aa1d32f30a43a33da3882db83e7d0777da55978.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "JWU".**
